name: The Westin Riverwalk
positioning: The Westin Riverwalk, San Antonio: a downtown hotel on the River Walk with Spanish Colonial-style rooms, a heated outdoor pool and a walk to the Alamo
best_for: Travelers who want to stay on the River Walk within walking distance of the Alamo
Couples and families who want rooms with a balcony or terrace and River Walk or city views

facts.text: Rooms have views of the River Walk or the cityscape.
Upscale suites offer separate living, work and sleeping areas.
The hotel is in a quiet section of the River Walk.
The lobby has River Walk views.
Zocca Cuisine D'Italia has an indoor-outdoor bar and patio on the River Walk.
A pool bar overlooking the outdoor pool serves handcrafted cocktails and light pub fare on a sunlit patio.
Guests can enjoy live music on select days, river parades and culture-centric events.
Run Concierges lead guided group runs from the lobby every Tuesday and Thursday at 6am, weather permitting.
Kids are greeted at check-in with an amenity bag including a world map and make-your-own postcards.
The hotel is dog-friendly for dogs up to 40 pounds, with a Westin Heavenly Dog Bed and pet welcome kit provided.

highlights.text: The hotel is on the San Antonio River Walk in downtown San Antonio.
The heated outdoor pool has views of the River Walk and the Tower of the Americas, with a garden-style pool deck.
Rooms have Spanish Colonial decor with rust-red colors, dark wood and iron accents.
Rooms have a Westin Heavenly Bed, a private balcony or terrace and a marble bathroom with a spa-style shower.
The Alamo is under half a mile away and can be reached on foot.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
The hotel is about 8.5 miles from San Antonio International Airport.
WhataHotel notes the River Walk area can be lively and crowded, especially on weekends and during festivals.
